```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(htmlwidgets)

data <- readRDS("hki-city-bike-usage-yearly.rds") |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |>
  arrange(year)

stations <- readRDS("hki-city-bike-stations.rds") |>
  filter(station != "") |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

years <- c("All", sort(unique(stations$year), decreasing = TRUE))

departures_by_year <- lapply(years, function(yr) {
  d <- if (yr == "All") stations else stations |> filter(year == yr)
  d |>
    group_by(station) |>
    summarise(departures = sum(departures, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(departures))
})

arrivals_by_year <- lapply(years, function(yr) {
  d <- if (yr == "All") stations else stations |> filter(year == yr)
  d |>
    group_by(station) |>
    summarise(arrivals = sum(arrivals, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(arrivals))
})

title_font <- list(family = "Outfit, sans-serif", size = 13, color = "#1a1a1a")
accent_color <- "#FCBC19"
```

## Row {height="550px"}

### Column

```{r}
#| label: bike-journeys-by-year
plot_ly(data,
        x = ~year,
        y = ~count,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        line = list(color = accent_color, width = 3, shape = "spline"),
        marker = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 10,
                      line = list(color = accent_color, width = 3)),
        hovertext = ~paste0(year, ": ", format(round(count, 1), nsmall = 1),
                             "M bike journeys"),
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "<b>City bike journeys by year</b>", font = title_font, x = 0),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#333333",
      bordercolor = "#333333",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = "",
                 tickvals = data$year,
                 tickformat = "d",
                 range = c(min(data$year) - 0.4, max(data$year) + 0.6),
                 showgrid = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 11),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Journeys (millions)",
                 titlefont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#1a1a1a"),
                 range = c(0, max(data$count) * 1.3),
                 dtick = 1,
                 tickformat = "d",
                 showgrid = FALSE,
                 showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 11),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    margin = list(t = 40, r = 30),
    annotations = lapply(1:nrow(data), function(i) {
      list(
        x = data$year[i],
        y = data$count[i],
        text = paste0("<b>", format(round(data$count[i], 1), nsmall = 1), "</b>M"),
        showarrow = FALSE,
        yanchor = "bottom",
        yshift = 10,
        font = list(color = "#1a1a1a", size = 12, family = "Inter, sans-serif")
      )
    })
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

## Row {height="500px"}

### Column

```{r}
#| label: top-departure-stations
#| title: "Most popular departure stations"
departures_json <- lapply(departures_by_year, function(d) {
  unname(lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) list(d$station[i], d$departures[i])))
})
names(departures_json) <- years

datatable(departures_by_year[[1]],
          colnames = c("Station" = "station", "Departures" = "departures"),
          rownames = FALSE,
          elementId = "departures-table",
          options = list(
            pageLength = 10,
            lengthChange = FALSE,
            dom = "tip",
            scrollY = "300px",
            scrollCollapse = TRUE
          )) |>
  formatCurrency("Departures", currency = "", interval = 3, mark = " ", digits = 0) |>
  onRender(
    "
    function(el, x, data) {
      var yearData = data.years;
      var yearNames = data.yearNames;

      var select = document.createElement('select');
      select.className = 'year-filter-select';
      yearNames.forEach(function(yr) {
        var opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = yr;
        opt.text = yr;
        select.appendChild(opt);
      });

      var card = el.closest('.card');
      var header = card ? card.querySelector('.card-header') : null;
      if (header) {
        header.appendChild(select);
      } else {
        var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.className = 'year-filter';
        wrapper.appendChild(select);
        el.insertBefore(wrapper, el.firstChild);
      }

      select.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var table = $(el).find('table').DataTable();
        table.clear();
        table.rows.add(yearData[this.value]);
        table.draw();
      });
    }
    ",
    data = list(years = departures_json, yearNames = years)
  )
```
